lead_in: Ephesians 4:7–8 quotes Psalm 68; Augustine on the psalm’s “received gifts in men” and the Apostle’s “gave gifts to men.”

excerpt.text: And let it not move us that the Apostle making mention of that same testimony says not, You have received gifts in men; but, He has given gifts unto men. For he with Apostolic authority has spoken thus according to the faith that the Son is God with the Father. For in respect of this He has given gifts to men, sending to them the Holy Spirit, which is the Spirit of the Father and of the Son.
excerpt.attribution: St Augustine, Exposition on Psalm 68 (Vulg. 67), §22, in Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, series 1, vol. 8
